title: Real-valued leading-coordinate product
statement: Let $g:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, let $b\in\{−1,1\}$, and let $x\in\{−1,1\}^n$. The real-valued version of the leading-coordinate product function at the input $(b,x)$ equals the real value of $b$ multiplied by the real-valued version of $g$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$x$ is an input in the sign cube
